changes.summary: 练习不再自动朗读、看过提示才能播放；拼错后可直接重打；随机拒收外语词；补全主题/模型/词源标签；文档真正截断且 id 用全文；取消星标的行先留在原页。
第一次拼错的词与跳过的词一起进入复习，进度点用琥珀区分；补全七处界面硬编码；随机只从五种在用语里选词。
星标的练习来源可以选一种语言；图谱从这一版起随版本校验。
跳过当前词并在组末回到被跳过的词；删掉两张西语死卡、列表按组过滤、每行可置顶；新增这张功能地图。
练习直接给词性与释义、提示给音标 / 声调 / 拍数；卡名随界面语言；分组常驻恢复；DOCX；保留换行；信达雅。

nodes.label: App shell
nodes.summary: Hash router, top bar, three-tab bar, theme, interface language, first paint. Also the first-run order: import prompt → tour.

nodes.label: Router
nodes.summary: Four routes; scroll is remembered per route; leaving the word view aborts its requests.

nodes.label: Bottom tabs
nodes.summary: Dictionary / Starred / Profile — the only navigation. Real links, so they can be opened in a new tab.

nodes.label: Dictionary
nodes.summary: Search, the four lookup types, the language picker, Surprise, candidates, and history grouped by day.

nodes.label: Auto · Word · Sentence · File
nodes.summary: Auto guesses between word and sentence at no cost, and falls back to sentence analysis when a word lookup says not_found.

nodes.label: Accent rescue
nodes.summary: Typing cote in a language with accents asks for the accented candidates first; a form that is itself valid is offered at the top, marked you typed this.

nodes.label: Reverse lookup
nodes.summary: A non-Latin query while a Latin-script language is pinned asks for candidate headwords instead of failing.

nodes.label: Surprise me
nodes.summary: One beautiful word, remembered so it is never repeated (100 remembered), shown for a beat before the ordinary lookup runs.

nodes.label: History
nodes.summary: One group per calendar day, foldable, searchable by word and gloss (accent-insensitive), each row starred or deleted with undo.

nodes.label: Entry page
nodes.summary: Word header, four request lines, the card sections, forms paradigms, explanation-language switch, collapse/expand.

nodes.label: Overview request
nodes.summary: One small request: language, reading, part of speech, one-line gloss, register, tags. The language it names decides the entry id and the prompts.

nodes.label: Four deep lines
nodes.summary: Etymology, usage, inflection and distinction run in parallel; Japanese and Chinese get three because they have no paradigm to tabulate. Each line fails and retries on its own.

nodes.label: 40 word cards
nodes.summary: One card per idea, rendered only when its field is non-empty; grouped Word DNA / Meaning / Forms / Context, Word DNA first.

nodes.label: Word DNA block
nodes.summary: The root cards share one container with a guide line, so the first thing a reader meets is where the word came from.

nodes.label: Forms & paradigms
nodes.summary: Tense by person tables, German four-case declension, adjective endings — folded per tense, with card-level expand and collapse.

nodes.label: Explanation language
nodes.summary: One default per source language in Profile; the entry toolbar switches this one entry, and the id carries the language so switching back is a cache hit.

nodes.label: Sentence analysis
nodes.summary: Two parallel lines: meaning (translation, word by word, chunks) and grammar (structure, grammar, register, pitfalls, pattern, culture).

nodes.label: File analysis
nodes.summary: Pick a file, name its language, get a summary, a translation, a glossary and a register note. Long files are read in parts you can watch and stop.

nodes.label: Text extraction
nodes.summary: Text, Markdown, CSV, subtitles, HTML, PDF (pdf.js, vendored) and DOCX (zip plus DecompressionStream). Keeps line breaks and blank lines; rebuilds PDF lines from y positions.

nodes.label: Chunked reading
nodes.summary: About 20,000 characters per request with overlap, one merge request at the end; up to 200,000 characters, then the file is refused with its size.

nodes.label: Document page
nodes.summary: Four cards fed by the assembled parts; progress, Stop and Continue in the header; the translation keeps the source shape. The stored entry keeps 60,000 characters of source and says so.

nodes.label: Starred
nodes.summary: The full set of starred entries, grouped by language, with a practice source selector and wordbooks. A row just unstarred keeps its place with a hollow star until the screen is left.

nodes.label: Wordbooks
nodes.summary: Named subsets of the starred set, cross-language, many-to-many; deleting a book only unlinks.

nodes.label: Words / Sentences / Files
nodes.summary: Inside a language: headwords first, then sentences, then documents — the label appears only when more than one kind is present.

nodes.label: Practice source
nodes.summary: One control with three tiers: everything starred, one language, or one wordbook. The choice narrows the list and the pool together, so a round only mixes languages when you ask for all of them.

nodes.label: Practice layer
nodes.summary: A modal spelling drill: prompt (part of speech and meaning) from the first frame, then typed input judged by language. Nothing is spoken until a hint has been asked for, and typing after a mistake starts a clean attempt.

nodes.label: Spell · Pinyin · Kana
nodes.zh: 拼写 / 拼音 / 假名
nodes.summary: Latin languages spell the word; Chinese types the pinyin (tone-aware); Japanese types kana or romaji, and katakana words in katakana.

nodes.label: Hints
nodes.summary: First hint is IPA for Latin languages, the tone pattern for Chinese and the mora count for Japanese — never the answer. Second hint is the first character.

nodes.label: Skip, fail & loop
nodes.summary: Skipping a word and failing it on the first try both queue it for the next pass, in the order they happened; the dot row marks skips pale blue and misses pale amber. Close is always available.

nodes.label: Normalisers
nodes.summary: Pinyin with or without tone marks, romaji to kana, hiragana to katakana, long vowels; judging happens on normalised forms.

nodes.label: Profile
nodes.summary: Key, model, per-language explanation defaults, appearance, card preferences, storage, backup, reset, about.

nodes.label: Card preferences
nodes.summary: Four groups; only the cards a group can produce are listed (25 / 17 / 16 / 9). Each row hides, moves up or down, or goes straight to the top; each group restores on its own.

nodes.label: Explanation defaults
nodes.summary: One row per source language: an English word can be explained in English, a Japanese one in Chinese.

nodes.label: Interface language
nodes.summary: Five languages, default Chinese, independent of the explanation language.

nodes.label: Backup & reset
nodes.summary: Export and import JSON (the key is never included), storage report, prune, clear history, stars and cache — each destructive action confirmed.

nodes.label: First-run tour
nodes.summary: Nine spotlight steps across the screens, re-playable from Profile; the card is positioned by a pure function, so a step cannot land off screen.

nodes.label: Storage
nodes.summary: One namespaced key per entry, a history index and wordbooks cached in memory; quota failures prune the oldest unstarred entries and say so if they cannot.

nodes.label: Entry identity
nodes.summary: slug, fingerprint, source language, model and explanation language, so the same word in two languages, or in two explanation languages, never collides. A document is fingerprinted over its whole text.

nodes.label: Import from 5.x
nodes.summary: dict5 into dict6 (then dict4, dict3): one read, re-keyed, de-duplicated; the old prefix is never written.

nodes.label: strings.js
nodes.summary: 420 keys in 5 languages, written per language rather than translated word for word; a missing key falls back to English, then to the key itself.

nodes.label: DeepSeek client
nodes.summary: The only place that fetches. JSON mode, no thinking, abortable, 45 s for lookups and 90 s for a document part, retries on 429, 5xx, network and timeout.

nodes.label: Prompt library
nodes.summary: Seven source languages by seven explanation languages, table-driven; overview, four deep lines, sentence, document and small helper prompts share one set of honesty and length rules.

nodes.label: Error kinds
nodes.summary: No key, auth, balance, rate limit, timeout, network, offline, bad json, language unclear, aborted — each with its own sentence and next action.

nodes.label: Build
nodes.summary: Writes dist/site (allowlist) and the single offline file, then asserts both: no external references, the worker inlined, one script block per module.

nodes.label: 765 assertions
nodes.summary: A dependency-free harness that loads the real modules in index.html order into a stubbed browser and drives them.

nodes.label: Preview & shots
nodes.summary: Nineteen panels rendered from the real view code with sample data; each panel can be screenshotted on its own.

nodes.label: Measure
nodes.summary: Real calls with the user's key: time per request, output size, truncation, and the document pipeline part by part.

nodes.label: PWA & offline
nodes.summary: Shell precache, install prompt, and a single-file build for file:// — the service worker is optional everywhere.

nodes.label: Desktop & mobile (later)
nodes.summary: Electron portable exe, Android as a local web page or PWA, Apple via PWA first. The four invariants that keep it cheap are tested.
